title: Bedoly BDL-B6090-7
subtitle: Cylinder Bed Computer Controlled Lockstitch Sewing Machine

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Bedoly BDL-B6090-7 is a cylinder-bed computer-controlled lockstitch machine for tubular / circular sewing where standard flat-bed machines cannot reach. The 78 cm cylinder length and 195 mm perimeter allow access to small spaces — trouser bottoms, sleeve cuffs, elastic waist sewing, cylindrical bags, rollover loops, glove brand work.
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (trousers, sleeves, cuffs, gloves, small parts)

overviewDescription: Made by Bedoly / Ningbo Sanhexin Automation Co., Ltd. (Zhenhai, Ningbo, China). Part of the BDL6090 series in Bedoly's 'Cylinder bed sewing machine' category. Published with Tier-1 specifications for the `-2TL` full-auto variant; the bare `-7` variant shares the headline specs but without the auto trimmer and top/lower double roller. The machine features a lock-stitch design, oil-free machine head structure (per the brand's patent claim), and dual-mode presser foot lifting (automatic or knee-touch).
